_comment: TOKEN PIP reading the 'department' claim emitted by the parity-end-user client protocol mapper. Bound to subject.parityDepartment so CLANG / RLS rows can reference it as a scalar string.
name: subject.parityDepartment

_comment: TOKEN PIP reading the 'tier' claim emitted by the parity-end-user client protocol mapper. Bound to subject.parityTier.
name: subject.parityTier

_comment: HEADER PIP reading the 'x-parity-pip-attribute' custom header. Bound to subject.parityHeaderAttr. The header name is deliberately NOT in ProhibitedHeaders (ProhibitedHeaders.java:11-22) so HeadersFilter does not strip it in transit — the Go helper's filterCustomHeaders mirror test covers that separately (row 48).
name: subject.parityHeaderAttr

_comment: GENERAL PIP hitting the Compose-network pip-mock and returning a JSON object. Legacy simplified-policy validation resolves only direct PIP aliases in conditions, not nested property access off a JSON-object alias, so the suite extracts dict leaves into first-class subject attributes via jsonPath. This PIP extracts the 'department' string leaf from the dict-returning response.
name: subject.parityMetaDepartment

_comment: Second leaf-extraction alias for the same dict-returning GENERAL PIP. Extracts the numeric 'maxAmount' leaf so conditions can compare resource.amount against the mocked budget without using unsupported nested-property syntax.
name: subject.parityMetaMaxAmount

_comment: Third leaf-extraction alias for the same dict-returning GENERAL PIP. Extracts the ids array from the mocked JSON object so future filter/bulk rows can reuse the dict-returning endpoint while still referring to a direct PIP alias the simplified-policy validator accepts.
name: subject.parityMetaIds

_comment: GENERAL PIP returning a JSON object {"value":"<status>"}. The harness pins the mock to that exact shape and jsonPath=$.value extracts the inner string. Used by SUB row 68 via ${subject.parityStatusScalar} substitution into an rsqlPredicate template — the substituted rendered predicate becomes 'status==<value>'.
name: subject.parityStatusScalar

_comment: GENERAL PIP returning a JSON array of status strings. Used by the CLANG row that exercises IN against a PIP-backed collection rather than a literal collection.
name: subject.parityStatusAllowed

_comment: GENERAL scalar-number PIP. The harness returns {"value":1000} and jsonPath extracts the number for numeric substitution into RSQL / SQL templates.
name: subject.parityMaxAmountScalar

_comment: GENERAL scalar-boolean PIP. The harness returns {"value":false} and jsonPath extracts the boolean for substitution into a predicate template.
name: subject.parityArchivedScalar

_comment: GENERAL scalar-string PIP used specifically for the special-characters substitution case. The suite pins strings containing commas / semicolons / quotes and records the exact legacy rendering.
name: subject.parityTagScalar
